test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which country has the longest written constitution in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __India.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution of India is the longest written constitution of any sovereign country in the world, containing 448 articles grouped in 25 parts with 12 schedules.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• There were 395 articles originally in the Constitution of India.
 
• The Indian Constitution was originally written in English.
 
• Prem Behari Narain Raizada wrote the Indian constitution by hand.
 
• Dr. BR Ambedkar is known as the father of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Indian Constitution was adopted by the Constituent Assembly of India on 26 November 1949 and became effective on 26 January 1950.
